AMSL 1101 — Elementary ASL 1 | prerequisites, offerings, professors (Northeastern)

NU Map is an independent, student-built planner — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data comes from the public catalog on a schedule; confirm with the official catalog and an advisor. Data updated Aug 2026 · page generated 2026-08-04.

4 semester hoursUndergraduateLectureusually offered: fall, springtypical days: M/W/ThBostonOnlineOnlineTraditional

Introduces students to American Sign Language (ASL). Students develop expressive and receptive competence in using ASL to fulfill various social functions (such as introductions, explanations of personal history, and descriptions of simple narratives). Additional topics include the use of signing space and further use of nonmanual components including facial expression and body postures.
